description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface 'NoteDao' for managing notes within an Android application using Room persistence library. It includes queries for retrieving, searching, inserting, updating, and deleting note entities in the local database.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: An interface annotated with @Dao, providing database access methods for NoteEntity objects, including reactive flows and suspend functions for CRUD operations.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting lists of all notes that are not marked as deleted, ordered by last update time.

methods.name: observeSearch
methods.description: Performs a search across note titles and content using LIKE query with escape characters, emitting matching notes as a reactive Flow.

methods.name: observeById
methods.description: Returns a Flow with the note matching the given ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspended function retrieving a single note by ID with proper update semantics, or null if not found.

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes marked as 'dirty', indicating they need synchronization or updating.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a note entity in the database.

methods.name: upsertAll
methods.description: Inserts or replaces multiple note entities in a batch operation.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted by setting 'deleted' to 1 and 'dirty' to 1, updating the timestamp.

methods.name: markClean
methods.description: Marks notes as clean (not dirty) based on a list of IDs.

methods.name: purgeDeleted
methods.description: Deletes all notes marked as deleted from the database.

methods.name: upsertInTransaction
methods.description: Performs a transaction to batch upsert multiple notes for atomicity.
